_comment: The tuned parameters of the statistical ensemble judge, as published.
These eight values are configuration, not a result: ensemble_judge.py needs
them to reproduce the tuned ensemble, and its dataclass defaults are the
untuned starting point rather than these. They were extracted from the
tuning run's own artefact so the ensemble stays reproducible after the
result data was archived away from this repository.
Provenance: 300 random-search trials over 6 knobs, tuned on seeds
111/222/333 at 10 instances per family and reported on seed 20260621 at 20.
Best objective 0.825, mean 0.753, worst 0.642 across the 300 trials. The
full trial log lives with the archived result data, in
use_recovery_guard is a structural ablation switch, not a tuned magnitude,
which is why the knob count is 6 and not 7.
